name: gke-live-campaign-controller-overlay-sync
description: Live campaign-controller config lives in the gitignored deploy/k8s/overlays/gke-live-campaign-controller: before any kubectl apply -k, sync newTag from the live Deployment image AND CAMPAIGN_ID from the live env (kubectl -n warren get deploy/campaign-controller -o json), or the apply rolls them back. Operator change summaries mount via configMapGenerator entry config/summaries.json + CAMPAIGN_SUMMARIES_PATH=/app/config/summaries.json env; the pr_intent stage skips with skipped_no_summary until that file carries the issue-keyed PrIntentSummaryFacts.

deploy-gke renders repo variables into strategic-merge Deployment env patches; an unquoted 'value: ${value}' turns numeric variables (4096, 1) into YAML integers and the apiserver rejects the patch ('The request is invalid'), failing the whole deploy job.
resolution: Quote the rendered value (PR #1200). Deploys are manual workflow_dispatch of main (deploy=true), not push-triggered.
